summary: Two hunters stranded in snow and sub-zero conditions after their truck got stuck about a week earlier in a 408-square-mile game management area north of Walden; their friends contacted CO4x4RnR on Nov 11, which coordinated with the Jackson County Sheriff's Office; a 7-member team (5 more on standby) found both hunters just before noon after they had hiked miles through deep snow - exhausted and dehydrated; returned to Walden, mission complete ~1:30 PM
location: game management area north of Walden
responding_agency: Colorado 4x4 Rescue and Recovery (SAR Emergency Support team); Jackson County Sheriff's Office
notes: Parent-opened mission report 2026-09-16. Day of observance (Veterans Day observed); friends called Nov 11, mission ran Nov 12.
